full_page.content:
Page 106 Oct. 18 Mother of Joanne M. Du Rivaje - three days later also unconscious 22 weeks ... is here To-day quite well asking for prayers for deaf daughter.
Harriett Moore - 58 - Mercywood San. - good - faithful
Barbara Manion - 6 - in hopeless convulsions Tuesday last week was enrolled % phone - slept afterwards O.K. - is here Today seemingly well - no trouble since-Enrolled perp'tu'ly 5.
19 Baby Garry Tromble - 22 month - spinal maningitis three weeks last Saturday - 107 fever at times. Enrolled at 4;10 p.m.
Joseph Keenan - 42 - Complication - heart .... has foold Drs and got well a number of times etc ..
Tho's J. Pinkey - 55 - some kind blood poison Mrs. Jas. Land of Bay City - husband going astray
Page 107
Oct. 27 Angus Cameron - 45 - Emmet, Mich. - bronchitis - hardening of ar- teries.
Kathlyn C. Canki - 29 - lukemia - hopeless blood disease - away from sacraments many years - had marriage blessed recently and back to Church.
Patrick McCarthy - 44 - Very threatening lip-cancer. Threatened starvation.
Baby Christine Jarvis - 6 mo. - very peculiar weakness of neck, etc. For three months. Not expected to live ... now improving slowly - En- rolled To-day.
Elizabeth Moleski - 34 - peculiar pains in chest and near heart. Eliz. Bryant - 33 - in Grace on back 3 months almost - from no sleep ... Gert. Wohn - 49 - has 6 daugh. - husband.
Page 108 Oct. 29 Eliz. Bryant - 33 - again - in oxigen tent two weeks. After operation - now almost desperate without sleep - in constant pain ......
